# Show-ZbxWatch

## SYNOPSIS

Draws a watch's current values as a table in the console.

## SYNTAX

```
Show-ZbxWatch [-Name] <string> [-Live] [-Interval <TimeSpan>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Show-ZbxWatch cmdlet draws the newest value of each item the watch named in -Name collects, as a console table, one row per item. Without -Live it draws the table once and returns; with -Live it redraws every -Interval until Ctrl+C. It reads only what the watch holds and sends nothing to the server. Watch-ZbxItem starts the watch.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Show a watch's values once

```powershell
Show-ZbxWatch -Name 'web'
```

The table shows the newest value of each item of web-01 the watch has collected so far. Add -Live, in an interactive console, to redraw it every -Interval until Ctrl+C.
